title: BackBox 10 "Resolute Raccoon" release announced
content_md:
A new version of BackBox 10, codenamed "Resolute Raccoon," has been released. BackBox is a specialized Linux distribution designed for testing.

via Mastodon https://linuxiarze.pl/backbox-10/
exclude_reason: Penetration-test distro release announcement, not a security event.
